# netbox_module_bay (Resource)

Manages a NetBox module bay (`/api/dcim/module-bays/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_module_bay" "example" {
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `installed_module_id` (Number) ID of the Module (`netbox_module`).
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_bay_type_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Module Bay Type (`netbox_module_bay_type`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_id` (Number) ID of the Module (`netbox_module`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `position` (String) Identifier to reference when renaming installed components. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_module_bay can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_module_bay.example 123
```
